params.message:
Remove what nothing calls or reads; test databases clean up after themselves

Every test run on the box left its temporary databases in /tmp (4,655 by 2026-09-29,
2.2 GB): most test files never call cleanup(), and the db-path fallback never removed
its own. Both now go when the process exits, and auto-deploy sweeps what a timed-out
run leaves.

Gone because nothing calls or reads them: twelve server routes (/graph-data,
/system-map with system-map.mjs, /source-analytics, /apify-usage, /explain, /phases,
/drive-ingest, /report-audit, four /quality routes), eight one-off scripts, eleven
exports, and in self-improve the prompt optimisation (it promoted variants nothing
read), the benchmark, agent benchmark and debate (nothing ran them).
